restaurant.name: El Farm Cafe and Restaurant
restaurant.subTagline: Your little escape in Lamitan City — Coffee • Matcha • Desserts • Good Food • Pickleball & Outdoor Experiences
restaurant.storyHeadline: Malayo Man Kami, Sulit Naman Ang Dayo.
restaurant.storyBody: Tucked away in the lush greenery of Sitio Nipa, Brgy. Maloong Canal, Lamitan City, El Farm Cafe and Restaurant was born as a warm sanctuary where rustic farm charm meets specialty coffee, authentic Basilan & Filipino comfort cuisine, and vibrant outdoor recreation. Whether you're rallying on our lighted pickleball court under the palms, sharing a Salu-Salo Bilao with family under glowing garden string lights, or savoring a Coconut Matcha Cloud in a real buko shell, every visit is crafted for meaningful moments.
restaurant.address: Sitio Nipa, Brgy. Maloong Canal, Lamitan City, Basilan, Philippines, 7302

hours.specialEvents: Tuesday Specials & Surprises (Lucky Egg Hunt) • Mon/Wed/Fri Goto Overload
hours.orderingNote: All meals are freshly prepared! Message us your advance orders ahead of your visit for faster serving, or enjoy delivery across Lamitan City (+₱100 delivery fee).

menuItems.name: Dirty Coffee (Iced Only)
menuItems.description: Freshly pulled hot espresso layered over ice-cold milk in a frosted glass. No ice cubes. No stirring. Just pure coffee magic.

menuItems.name: Butter Caramel Popcorn Latte
menuItems.description: Rich espresso and velvety milk swirled with buttery caramel sauce, crowned with whipped cream and golden caramel popcorn crunch.

menuItems.name: Lamitan Sunrise
menuItems.description: Our signature hometown coffee creation inspired by golden mornings at Sitio Nipa. Available hot or iced.

menuItems.name: Biscoff Latte
menuItems.description: Creamy espresso latte infused with caramelized Lotus Biscoff spread and spiced speculoos cookie crumble.

menuItems.name: Honeycomb Latte
menuItems.description: Smooth espresso paired with golden honeycomb sweetness and silky steamed or chilled milk. (Oat Milk add-on +₱30)

menuItems.name: Spanish Latte
menuItems.description: Rich double-shot espresso balanced with sweetened condensed milk and textured fresh milk.

menuItems.name: Salted Caramel Latte
menuItems.description: Velvety espresso blended with house salted caramel drizzle and creamy milk.

menuItems.name: Brown Sugar Cinnamon Latte
menuItems.description: Warm aromatic cinnamon and caramelized dark brown sugar shaken with bold espresso and milk.

menuItems.name: Classic Americano
menuItems.description: Pure, bold freshly pulled espresso shots lengthened with hot water or poured over crystal ice.

menuItems.name: Coconut Matcha Cloud Latte
menuItems.description: Refreshing young coconut water topped with a velvety ceremonial matcha cream cloud, served inside a real fresh buko shell with tender coconut meat.

menuItems.name: EL Special Matcha Latte – Dunya
menuItems.description: Our signature elevated ceremonial matcha creation crafted with rich layered notes and silky texture.

menuItems.name: Hojicha Earl Grey Latte
menuItems.description: Roasted Japanese green tea harmonized with aromatic bergamot Earl Grey infusion and creamy milk.

menuItems.name: Classic Matcha Latte
menuItems.description: Whisked earthy Japanese green tea poured over velvety milk. (Oat Milk add-on +₱30)

menuItems.name: Roasted Hojicha Latte
menuItems.description: Toasty, nutty Japanese roasted green tea latte with a smooth, comforting finish.

menuItems.name: Dubai Chewy Cookie Smoothie
menuItems.description: A rich chocolate smoothie blended with chewy cookie crumble and a luxurious hint of roasted pistachio.

menuItems.name: S'mores Smoothie
menuItems.description: A decadent chocolatey ice-blended drink crowned with torched marshmallows and buttery graham cracker crunch.

menuItems.name: Artisanal Fruit Yoghurt Drinks
menuItems.description: Tangy, probiotic-rich chilled yoghurt refreshers swirled with real Mulberry, Blueberry, or Strawberry compote.

menuItems.name: Tiyula Itum (Traditional Black Beef Soup)
menuItems.description: Basilan's iconic black beef soup, slow-cooked with toasted coconut, burnt spices, lemongrass, and traditional heirloom aromatics.

menuItems.name: Chicken Kaliya
menuItems.description: Tender chicken simmered in a rich and fragrant spiced coconut sauce — a beloved Yakan & Basilan culinary treasure.

menuItems.name: Native Chicken Tinola
menuItems.description: Free-range native chicken slow-simmered in aromatic ginger, lemongrass, green papaya, and fresh chili leaves.

menuItems.name: Kare-Kareng Hito
menuItems.description: Crispy deep-fried catfish simmered in a rich, velvety roasted peanut sauce, served with fresh farm vegetables and savory bagoong alamang.

menuItems.name: Kambing Papaitan
menuItems.description: A hearty, citrusy, and deeply flavorful goat stew simmered with ginger, green chilies, and traditional spices.

menuItems.name: Traditional Adobing
menuItems.description: Tender chicken cooked to savory perfection with a traditional blend of soy, native vinegar, crushed garlic, and whole spices.

menuItems.name: Crispy Fried Hito
menuItems.description: Fresh local hito (catfish), deep-fried to a golden crackle on the outside while staying tender and flaky inside.

menuItems.name: Sizzling Bangus Sisig
menuItems.description: Sizzling boneless milkfish tossed with diced onions, chilies, a zesty Filipino-style dressing, and a fresh egg on top.

menuItems.name: Sizzling Chicken Sisig
menuItems.description: Sizzling chopped chicken seasoned with onions, chilies, a tangy savory house dressing, and crowned with a fresh egg.

menuItems.name: Golden Crispy Pata
menuItems.description: Deep-fried whole pork knuckle with ultra-crispy golden blistered skin and tender, juicy meat. Served with our signature soy-vinegar dipping sauce.

menuItems.name: Classic Sizzling Pork Sisig
menuItems.description: Classic Filipino sizzling sisig made with finely chopped pork, seasoned with onions, chili, calamansi, and special spices on a hot cast-iron plate with a fresh egg.

menuItems.name: Rich Savory Dinuguan
menuItems.description: A classic Filipino dish of tender pork cuts simmered in a rich and velvety savory gravy with a bright hint of native vinegar, garlic, and green chili.

menuItems.name: Putok Batok sa Goto (Bone Marrow Goto)
menuItems.description: Rich ginger-infused rice porridge topped with a massive torched beef bone marrow canoe, crispy toasted garlic, and spring onions.

menuItems.name: Goto Overload (Rich Beef Goto)
menuItems.description: Comforting ginger rice porridge loaded with tender beef tripe, boiled egg, chicharon crumbs, toasted garlic, and scallions.

menuItems.name: Sisig Silog
menuItems.description: Sizzling Kapampangan-style sisig served with fragrant sinangag (garlic fried rice) and a sunny-side-up egg.

menuItems.name: Spicy Samyang Wrap
menuItems.description: Fiery and creamy Samyang buldak noodles wrapped in a warm tortilla with crisp greens, cheese, and savory filling.

menuItems.name: Classic Beef Tapsilog
menuItems.description: Savory marinated beef tapa strips pan-seared and served with toasted garlic rice, sunny-side egg, and spiced vinegar.

menuItems.name: Pinoy Hotsilog
menuItems.description: Classic juicy red hotdogs served with golden garlic rice and a farm-fresh fried egg.

menuItems.name: S'mores & Walnut Brownie Cupcakes
menuItems.description: Fudgy dark chocolate brownie cupcakes crowned with either torched campfire marshmallow & graham or roasted California walnuts.

menuItems.name: Barkadahan Special Platter
menuItems.description: A crowd-pleasing sharing platter of golden kikiam, squid balls, fishballs, siomai, and crispy squid with sweet-spicy street sauces.

menuItems.name: Crispy Calamares
menuItems.description: Crispy battered and tender calamari squid rings fried golden and served with house creamy garlic aioli.

menuItems.name: Chix N' Fries
menuItems.description: Crispy golden chicken bites paired with seasoned shoestring fries and signature dipping sauce.

menuItems.name: Kamanting Con Haleya
menuItems.description: Soft boiled cassava (kamanting) drizzled with rich, slow-caramelized coconut cream and dark brown sugar haleya.

menuItems.name: Saging Con Ginamus
menuItems.description: Warm boiled saba bananas paired with savory-umami traditional ginamus dipped in calamansi and chili.

menuItems.name: Seafood Feast Bilao
menuItems.description: Steamed Garlic Rice, prized Zamboanga/Basilan Curacha (Spanner Crab), Crispy Garlic Shrimps, Crispy Calamares, and Seasonal Fresh Fruits.

menuItems.name: All-Time Favorites Combo Feast
menuItems.description: Crispy Fried Chicken (6 pcs), Assorted Inihaw Grilled Meats, Savory Pancit Miki, Steamed Garlic Rice, and Seasonal Fresh Fruits.

menuItems.name: Chicken & Pancit Miki Combo
menuItems.description: Crispy Juicy Fried Chicken (12 pcs), Classic Pancit Miki Bilao, Steamed Garlic Rice, and Seasonal Fresh Fruits.

menuItems.name: Pinoy Favorites Bilao
menuItems.description: Steamed Garlic Rice, Assorted Inihaw Meat, Crispy Deep-Fried Hito, Fresh Mango/Tomato Ensalada, Salted Egg, and Seasonal Fresh Fruits.

menuItems.name: Crispy Chicken Bilao (12 Pcs)
menuItems.description: Twelve pieces of golden-fried, juicy marinated chicken served with homemade gravy and dipping sauces.

menuItems.name: Classic Pancit Miki Bilao
menuItems.description: Our classic stir-fried thick egg noodles loaded with savory meat, crispy toppings, fresh vegetables, and calamansi.
